_about: Candidate home / furniture / decor brands (names only) that the design brief ranks for a person's taste via Qloo filter.results.entities. Edit freely: names are resolved to Qloo ids at runtime with /search (type brand, near-exact name match required) and cached; names Qloo does not know are reported in brief.json as brands_unresolved. Grouped by rough price point; the grouping is informational only.
